name: @siteborne/protocol-x402
description: x402 V2 credential-independent payment protocol foundation (SUN-0700A) — message construction, requirement/quote/resource binding, and structural payload validation. No facilitator client, no wallet, no settlement.

scripts.build: tsc && tsc -m ESNext --outDir dist/esm && mv dist/esm/*.mjs dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:property && pnpm run fixtures:verify
